howToUse.title: How to use
howToUse.text: Choose a mode, select how many cycles, press Start and follow the bubble. When it grows, inhale. When it shrinks, exhale.

relax.description: Coherent breathing. Optimizes heart rate variability and activates the parasympathetic system.

focus.description: Box breathing. Equal intervals create nervous system balance, calming without dulling.

sleep.description: 4-7-8 by Dr. Andrew Weil. Built specifically to help you fall asleep.
